# Cal.com — Style Reference

> Ink-black type on white bond paper, one black tab marking the appointment. Heavy geometric Cal Sans at weight 700 sits on a #ffffff canvas, 7% navy-tinted rings stand in for borders, and the only fill that acts is #242424 ink.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Cal.com speaks an ink-on-paper scheduling language: a #ffffff canvas (105 backgrounds), #f3f4f6 tiles as the only recessed surface (76 uses), a frosted #f4f4f4b8 sticky nav, and a #111111 footer as the single inverted slab. The brand's chromatic budget is zero, with two status hues. The primary action is #242424 ink rather than a color, and saturated hue appears only inside product mockups: #cc4510 on a "Booked" chip and #15803d on a "Confirmed" label. One family does everything. Cal Sans runs at 700 with -0.01em tracking for every headline from 17px to 80px, at 500 for controls, and at 400 for reading text at 14px (104 uses). Its top-end ratio of 1.41 (56 → 80) is steeper than a Perfect Fourth. Shape is softly rounded, with 12px buttons, 20px cards and full pills for avatars. Elevation is a 1px navy-tinted ring at 7% opacity rather than a drop shadow. The whole reads as a printed timetable set in heavy type rather than a colorful SaaS dashboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page ground, testimonial cards, the active accordion step and secondary buttons, 105 background uses — canvas and card share one white, so rings do the separating instead of tone. |
| Fog Tile | `#f3f4f6` | `--color-fog-tile` | Inactive accordion steps, bento inner tiles and the NEW badge fill, 76 uses — the only recessed tone, used to sink content rather than lift it. |
| Frosted Glass | `#f4f4f4b8` | `--color-frosted-glass` | The sticky nav bar's translucent fill over scrolling content — at 72% opacity the hero and mockups ghost through. Do not use it for cards or modals. |
| Sand Backdrop | `#e3dccd` | `--color-sand-backdrop` | Warm ground behind dithered photographs and the hero browser mockup, 14 uses — decorative warmth for imagery only. Do not promote it to a section background band. |
| Jet Footer | `#111111` | `--color-jet-footer` | The 1487px footer slab, the case-study pill base and mockup headings, 45 text uses — the deepest value, one step past ink. Keep it off buttons. |
| Ink | `#242424` | `--color-ink` | Every headline, nav link and body paragraph, plus the primary button fill, with 158 text and 37 background uses — the workhorse; on this site ink is the action color. |
| Graphite Body | `#374151` | `--color-graphite-body` | Secondary paragraph copy, testimonial attributions and footer link lists, 56 uses — a cool blue-gray one step under ink that stays fully legible. |
| Slate Caption | `#5f6570` | `--color-slate-caption` | Feature-card descriptions, mockup subtitles and helper lines, 75 uses — the default caption gray at roughly 6:1 contrast on white. |
| Pewter Lede | `#6a6e78` | `--color-pewter-lede` | The hero lede, the "No credit card required" line and the logo-wall caption, 72 combined uses — the quietest readable gray for marketing subtext. |
| Ash Hint | `#858993` | `--color-ash-hint` | Placeholders, keyboard hints and disabled labels, 7 uses — tertiary only. Do not set paragraph copy in it. |
| Mist Hairline | `#e5e7eb` | `--color-mist-hairline` | Secondary-button outlines, bento frames, row dividers and the announcement chip, 16 border uses — the only solid border color, since every other edge is a translucent ring. |
| Ember Signal | `#cc4510` | `--color-ember-signal` | The "Booked" check inside the hero headline chip, 1 use — status punctuation rather than decoration. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Moss Confirmed | `#15803d` | `--color-moss-confirmed` | "Confirmed" status text in the bookings mockup, set on a mockup-internal #dcfce7 tint, 1 use — a success signal only. Keep it out of marketing chrome. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Cal Sans — one geometric face carrying display, UI and body at four weights · `--font-cal-sans`

- **Substitute:** Plus Jakarta Sans at 800 for headlines and 500 for UI. Inter Display at 800 for headlines with Inter at 500 for UI. Manrope at 800 for headlines and 500 for UI. Cal Sans draws heavier than its nominal number: 700 renders like an 800 with tight apertures, and 400 reads closer to 450. Match that density, because a true 700 substitute will look anemic next to the screenshots.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 17px, 20px, 24px, 40px, 44px, 56px, 80px
- **Line height:** 1.0, 1.05, 1.08, 1.1, 1.3, 1.35, 1.4, 1.45, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** -0.8px at 80px, -0.56px at 56px, -0.44px at 44px, -0.4px at 40px, -0.2px at 20px bold, -0.17px at 17px bold, +0.66px at 11px badge caps, normal everywhere else
- **Role:** Every bold size is tracked at exactly -0.01em. That proportional tightening keeps the 80px hero and the 17px card title looking cut from the same block, where most sites track only display sizes. Hierarchy comes from weight 700 against 400/500 rather than from color, so Ink #242424 carries headlines and body alike. The top of the scale jumps 40 → 56 → 80 (ratio near 1.41, steeper than a Perfect Fourth 1.333), while the bottom crawls in 1px steps from 12px to 17px. The result is dense control text under monumental headlines.

### System UI (-apple-system) — the operating-system face that makes product mockups read as real software · `--font-system-ui`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400, Roboto at 400. Both match SF Pro's stroke at small sizes without drawing heavier.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 700
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px
- **Line height:** 1.0, 1.5, 1.54
- **Letter spacing:** normal at 12px and 13px
- **Role:** This face is confined to the bookings and inbox mockups (49 elements). Switching from Cal Sans to the native stack signals "this is the app, not the ad", a deliberate seam between marketing voice and product truth. Treat it as mockup-internal and do not use it in marketing copy.

### UI Monospace — keyboard hints and technical micro-labels · `--font-ui-monospace`

- **Substitute:** JetBrains Mono at 400, Geist Mono at 400
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 12px
- **Line height:** 1.8
- **Letter spacing:** normal at 12px
- **Role:** Monospace appears on 9 elements, such as the ⌘K search hint and code-like strings. The generous 1.8 line height lets it sit inline with 13px system text without crowding. It is rationed punctuation for the developer audience, not a voice.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Cal Sans | 500 | 11px | 1.0 | 0.66px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Cal Sans | 400 | 12px | 1.33 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Cal Sans | 400 | 13px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Cal Sans | 400 | 14px | 1.35 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Cal Sans | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Cal Sans | 700 | 17px | 1.3 | -0.17px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Cal Sans | 500 | 20px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Cal Sans | 700 | 40px | 1.1 | -0.4px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Cal Sans | 700 | 56px | 1.05 | -0.56px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Cal Sans | 700 | 80px | 1.08 | -0.8px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Cal Sans weight 700 with -0.01em tracking (-0.8px at 80px, -0.56px at 56px, -0.17px at 17px) — weight and tightness, not color, carry rank.
- Fill the primary action with #242424 and #ffffff text at a 12px radius and 36px height — ink as the action color is non-negotiable, and it is the brand's whole chromatic argument.
- Separate white-on-white surfaces with `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07)` — the navy cast keeps edges cool and nearly invisible on #ffffff.
- Recess with #f3f4f6 for inactive steps, inner bento tiles and badges — tone moves content down, so the page needs no drop shadows to create depth.
- Keep reading text at 14px weight 400 with line height 1.35, and ledes at 20px weight 500 in #6a6e78 — the small body under 80px display creates the timetable contrast.
- Confine saturated hue to status inside product objects (#cc4510 Booked, #15803d Confirmed) — color then means "real state", not decoration.
- Space sections 128px apart inside a 1320px container, and use 8px as the default element gap — generous macro rhythm offsets dense 36px controls.

### Don't

- Don't add a brand green or blue button because a competitor or a crawler suggests one — this system never spends a hue on action, and hierarchy made by weight 700 and #242424 ink collapses once a colored fill outranks the headline.
- Don't soften headlines to weight 600 or reset tracking to 0px at 56px — the heavy, tight setting is the voice, and loosening it reads as a generic SaaS template.
- Don't draw cards with `0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)` drop shadows — elevation here is a 1px ring at 7%, and blur shadows turn a flat timetable into floating stickers.
- Don't apply a 9999px radius to CTAs — buttons are 12px; full rounds belong to avatars and case-study pills only.
- Don't set paragraphs in #858993 Ash Hint — at roughly 3.5:1 it fails body contrast; use #5f6570 or #374151 for anything read.
- Don't introduce a second display face such as a serif at 56px — Cal Sans covers 11px to 80px, and a pairing dilutes the one-family discipline.
- Don't paint whole sections in #e3dccd sand — it is photo-backdrop warmth across 14 uses, and a sand band would add a third surface tone the system does not have.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- recessed surface: #f3f4f6 (Fog Tile)
- primary text: #242424 (Ink)
- secondary text: #5f6570 (Slate Caption)
- border: #e5e7eb (Mist Hairline)
- inverted surface: #111111 (Jet Footer)
- status: #cc4510 (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #242424 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars render in neutrals: #242424 for the primary series, #5f6570 and #e5e7eb for secondary series and gridlines, and #cc4510 or #15803d only as solid single-point status markers, so no data graphic outshouts the headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #242424, text #ffffff, border 1px solid #242424, border-radius 12px, padding 1px 14px 0, height 36px, inline-flex centered. Use Cal Sans 14px weight 500 with line height 1.5. Apply box-shadow `inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`. Next to it place a secondary button with identical dimensions but background #ffffff, text #242424, border 1px solid #e5e7eb and box-shadow `0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`, separated by an 8px gap.

2. Build a hero section on #ffffff inside a 1320px container, centered, with 128px top padding. First add an announcement chip: #ffffff, 1px solid #e5e7eb, 8px radius, 32px height, 0 12px 0 3px padding, Cal Sans 14px weight 500 #242424. It contains a NEW badge in #f3f4f6 with a 4px radius, 24px height, 0 8px padding, and 11px weight 500 caps tracked 0.66px. Below it, set a 24px gap and a two-line H1 in Cal Sans 80px weight 700, line height 1.08, letter-spacing -0.8px, color #242424. Embed one 14px-radius image tile mid-sentence. Then add a 20px weight 500 lede in #6a6e78, and two 64px-tall buttons with 14px radius and 0 15px padding: ink #242424 and hairline #ffffff with 1px #e5e7eb.

3. Build a bento feature card: outer #ffffff with box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px #e5e7eb`, 18px radius and 6px padding. Inside, place a #f3f4f6 tile with a 14px radius and 240px height that centers a white mini-panel (8px radius, shadow `inset 0 1px 0 0 #ffffff, 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.04)`). Below the tile, with 16px padding, add a title in Cal Sans 17px weight 700, letter-spacing -0.17px, #242424, then a 4px gap, then a description in Cal Sans 14px weight 400, line height 1.35, #5f6570.

4. Build a sticky navigation bar: 64px tall, positioned 12px from the top, inside a 1320px container. Fill it with #f4f4f4b8 and backdrop-filter blur(12px) at a 14px radius. Place the wordmark left at 22px height. Add ghost links in Cal Sans 14px weight 500 #242424 with 0 14px padding, 36px height and 10px radius, plus a #f3f4f6 hover fill. On the right, add a 24px avatar pair with a 2px #ffffff ring, "Talk to sales", "Sign in", and the 36px #242424 ink button with a 12px radius.

5. Build a testimonial card: background #ffffff, 20px radius, 24px padding, 420px width, box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07)`, no border. Set the quote in Cal Sans 16px weight 400, line height 1.5, #242424. Then add a 16px gap and a footer row with a 24px full-round avatar, the name in 14px weight 500 #242424 and the role in 13px weight 400 #5f6570, with an 8px gap between them.

### Ink Button — Compact (Primary)

**Role:** Nav and inline primary call-to-action

The inset sheen is the only gloss in the system — it marks this as the one pressable thing on the bar, and it does so without spending a hue.

### Ink Button — Hero (Primary, Large)

**Role:** Above-the-fold signup action

The compact button, scaled up. It is #242424 fill, #ffffff text, 1px solid #242424, 14px radius, 0 15px padding, 64px height and 312px width. The label is Cal Sans 20px weight 500 beside a 20px Google glyph, with the same md-2 sheen. The radius grows from 12px to 14px as the height nearly doubles, which keeps the corner visually proportional instead of reading as a sharper button. Use it once per page, paired with the hairline variant.

### Hairline Button — White (Secondary)

**Role:** Alternate path beside ink CTA

Quiet, outlined, still tactile. The spec is a #ffffff background, #242424 text, a 1px solid #e5e7eb border, a 12px radius (14px at hero size), 0 14px padding, 36px height and Cal Sans 14px weight 500. The subtle shadow is 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05). It deliberately shares every dimension with the ink button, so the pair differs only in fill — the visual equivalent of saying "or".

### Ghost Nav Link

**Role:** Top-level menu items and dropdown triggers

Transparent until touched. The spec is no background, #242424 text, no border, a 10px radius, 0 14px padding, 36px height and Cal Sans 14px weight 500. A chevron follows Products, Use cases, Features and Resources. The 10px radius, from the generic lg step, sits one step tighter than buttons, so hover fills read as softer selections rather than competing buttons.

### Floating Navigation Bar

**Role:** Sticky site header and command strip

Detached, rounded, translucent. The bar is a 64px sticky container filled with #f4f4f4b8 frosted glass at an estimated 14px radius, inset from the page edges within the 1320px container. The Cal.com wordmark sits left, six ghost links run in a group, and the right side carries avatar pair plus "Talk to sales", "Sign in" and the compact ink button. The floating capsule rejects the conventional full-bleed white header — the nav reads as a tool palette hovering over the page.

### Announcement Chip with NEW Badge

**Role:** Release callout above the headline

Small, bordered, editorial. The outer chip is #ffffff with #242424 text, a 1px solid #e5e7eb border, an 8px radius, 0 12px 0 3px padding, 32px height, in Cal Sans 14px weight 500. The inner badge is #f3f4f6, 4px radius, 0 8px padding, 24px tall, set in Cal Sans 11px weight 500 caps at +0.66px tracking. The badge is the only positively tracked text on the site — caps need air, and the exception proves the -0.01em rule elsewhere.

### Inline Headline Token

**Role:** Product fragments embedded in the H1

The signature hero move. Inside the 80px weight 700 headline, rounded objects replace whitespace between words: a dithered photograph at a 14px radius, an analog clock tile labelled NYC, and an "Intro call 30m" chip. That chip is #ffffff on a #f3f4f6 frame with a 14px radius (estimated), Cal Sans 13px weight 600, and a "Booked" line in #cc4510. This is the system outlier for color — the only saturated hue above the fold, allowed because it is status inside a product object, not brand decoration.

### Testimonial Card

**Role:** Masonry customer quote tile

White on white, held by a ring. The spec is a #ffffff background, #242424 text, no border, a 20px radius, 24px padding and a 420px column width. Body text is Cal Sans 16px weight 400 at line height 1.5, and the edge is the sm inset ring 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,35,75,0.07). The main content card — the navy-tinted 7% ring replaces the conventional gray border, so the card edge is felt rather than drawn.

### Accordion Step Card — Active / Inactive

**Role:** Problem-to-solution story beside photography

Stacked, tonal, stateful. The active step is #ffffff with the sm ring, a 22px radius, 20px 24px padding, a 17px weight 700 title in #242424 and a 16px weight 400 line in #5f6570. Inactive steps drop the ring and fill with #f3f4f6 at 65px collapsed height. At 22px the radius exceeds the 20px card radius — the deliberate outlier, so the stack reads as one soft column rather than separate cards.

### Bento Feature Card

**Role:** Product capability tiles in uneven grid

Frame, tile, caption. The outer frame is #ffffff with the sm-2 ring in #e5e7eb at an 18px radius (estimated). A #f3f4f6 inner tile with a 14px radius hosts a live UI vignette, such as an event-type row with 30m pill and time slots, or a routing select. Below it sits a Cal Sans 17px weight 700 title tracked -0.17px with 0 12px padding, and a 14px weight 400 description in #5f6570. Columns split two-thirds/one-third, then one-third/two-thirds — the rhythm alternates instead of repeating a 3-up grid.

### Product Mockup Window

**Role:** Hero proof of the real app

A macOS desktop in miniature. A dithered photograph on #e3dccd sand fills a 14px-radius frame, with a white Safari window carrying the md shadow. The traffic lights are mockup-internal (#ff5f57, #febc2e, #28c840, not system tokens). The app UI is set in System UI 13px with #5f6570 subtitles, and row dividers use subtle-2. Radii inside run at 8.57px — exactly 12px × 5/7 — because the mockup is the real interface scaled down, not a redraw.

### Logo Wall with Case-Study Pills

**Role:** Customer proof under the hero

Grayscale, two rows, six columns. A 13px #6a6e78 caption sits above monochrome wordmarks (Vercel, PlanetScale, Framer, Raycast, ramp, Udemy). Overlaid "Case study" pills are #111111 at 56% (#1111118f, not a system token), with a 9999px radius, #ffffff Cal Sans 12px weight 500 and 0 8px padding. Logos stay uncolored so the grid reads as a typeset list, and pills are the only full-round shapes besides avatars.

### Jet Footer

**Role:** Inverted close and sitemap

The one dark slab. The footer is a 1487px-tall #111111 field spanning the full 1920px width, with a mission statement and link columns in Cal Sans 14px weight 400 at line height 1.5. Labels run in #ffffff and links in a lightened gray. The site inverts exactly once, at the bottom — darkness is spent as a full stop, not as a section-alternation device.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Cal Sans weight 700 with -0.01em tracking (-0.8px at 80px, -0.56px at 56px, -0.17px at 17px) — weight and tightness, not color, carry rank.
- Fill the primary action with #242424 and #ffffff text at a 12px radius and 36px height — ink as the action color is non-negotiable, and it is the brand's whole chromatic argument.
- Separate white-on-white surfaces with `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07)` — the navy cast keeps edges cool and nearly invisible on #ffffff.
- Recess with #f3f4f6 for inactive steps, inner bento tiles and badges — tone moves content down, so the page needs no drop shadows to create depth.
- Keep reading text at 14px weight 400 with line height 1.35, and ledes at 20px weight 500 in #6a6e78 — the small body under 80px display creates the timetable contrast.
- Confine saturated hue to status inside product objects (#cc4510 Booked, #15803d Confirmed) — color then means "real state", not decoration.
- Space sections 128px apart inside a 1320px container, and use 8px as the default element gap — generous macro rhythm offsets dense 36px controls.

### Don't

- Don't add a brand green or blue button because a competitor or a crawler suggests one — this system never spends a hue on action, and hierarchy made by weight 700 and #242424 ink collapses once a colored fill outranks the headline.
- Don't soften headlines to weight 600 or reset tracking to 0px at 56px — the heavy, tight setting is the voice, and loosening it reads as a generic SaaS template.
- Don't draw cards with `0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)` drop shadows — elevation here is a 1px ring at 7%, and blur shadows turn a flat timetable into floating stickers.
- Don't apply a 9999px radius to CTAs — buttons are 12px; full rounds belong to avatars and case-study pills only.
- Don't set paragraphs in #858993 Ash Hint — at roughly 3.5:1 it fails body contrast; use #5f6570 or #374151 for anything read.
- Don't introduce a second display face such as a serif at 56px — Cal Sans covers 11px to 80px, and a pairing dilutes the one-family discipline.
- Don't paint whole sections in #e3dccd sand — it is photo-backdrop warmth across 14 uses, and a sand band would add a third surface tone the system does not have.

| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | Page ground, cards and active steps — one white for everything flat |

## Elevation

- **Testimonial cards, active accordion step, bento cards:** `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07)`
- **Bento outer frames, segmented controls:** `inset 0 0 0 1px #e5e7eb`
- **Mockup row dividers and tab underlines:** `inset 0 -1px 0 0 #e5e7eb`
- **Raised mockup panels and chips (50 uses, the most frequent):** `inset 0 1px 0 0 #ffffff, 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.04)`
- **Ink buttons:** `inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`
- **Hairline buttons:** `0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`
- **Mockup dropdowns and selects:** `0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`

## Imagery

Imagery is product screenshots set over photography. The hero shows a full macOS Safari window open on app.cal.com/bookings, framed at a 14px radius over a halftone-dithered photograph washed onto #e3dccd sand. The problem section pairs a dithered portrait with an email-thread mockup of "Re: Re: Intro call?" replies. Photographs never appear raw: the dot screen turns them into print texture, which keeps them tonally subordinate to the black type. Icons are thin outline glyphs at an estimated 1.5px stroke in #242424, and avatars are 24px full-round photos with a 2px white ring. There are no gradients, glows or orbs anywhere, and the only chromatic pixels are mockup-internal traffic lights and status labels. The narrative is "the real product, sitting on a printed page".

## Layout

Content sits in a 1320px container, with 640px and 760px columns for centered copy. Sections are separated by 128px, falling to 96px between tightly related blocks. The hero is centered: announcement chip, a two-line 80px headline with inline objects, a 20px lede, the paired 64px signup buttons, and then the full-width mockup. After the hero, sections alternate between split layouts (heading plus accordion left, photograph right) and full-width bento grids that split 2:1 then 1:2. Testimonials run in a three-column masonry of 420px cards, and the logo wall is 6 columns by 2 rows. The nav is a sticky 64px floating capsule in frosted glass, with the wordmark and menu left and sales, sign-in and the ink CTA right. The footer is one full-bleed #111111 slab. At 375px, use the 40px heading token for display text and 64px section gaps. Density: comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- recessed surface: #f3f4f6 (Fog Tile)
- primary text: #242424 (Ink)
- secondary text: #5f6570 (Slate Caption)
- border: #e5e7eb (Mist Hairline)
- inverted surface: #111111 (Jet Footer)
- status: #cc4510 (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #242424 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars render in neutrals: #242424 for the primary series, #5f6570 and #e5e7eb for secondary series and gridlines, and #cc4510 or #15803d only as solid single-point status markers, so no data graphic outshouts the headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #242424, text #ffffff, border 1px solid #242424, border-radius 12px, padding 1px 14px 0, height 36px, inline-flex centered. Use Cal Sans 14px weight 500 with line height 1.5. Apply box-shadow `inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`. Next to it place a secondary button with identical dimensions but background #ffffff, text #242424, border 1px solid #e5e7eb and box-shadow `0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`, separated by an 8px gap.

2. Build a hero section on #ffffff inside a 1320px container, centered, with 128px top padding. First add an announcement chip: #ffffff, 1px solid #e5e7eb, 8px radius, 32px height, 0 12px 0 3px padding, Cal Sans 14px weight 500 #242424. It contains a NEW badge in #f3f4f6 with a 4px radius, 24px height, 0 8px padding, and 11px weight 500 caps tracked 0.66px. Below it, set a 24px gap and a two-line H1 in Cal Sans 80px weight 700, line height 1.08, letter-spacing -0.8px, color #242424. Embed one 14px-radius image tile mid-sentence. Then add a 20px weight 500 lede in #6a6e78, and two 64px-tall buttons with 14px radius and 0 15px padding: ink #242424 and hairline #ffffff with 1px #e5e7eb.

3. Build a bento feature card: outer #ffffff with box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px #e5e7eb`, 18px radius and 6px padding. Inside, place a #f3f4f6 tile with a 14px radius and 240px height that centers a white mini-panel (8px radius, shadow `inset 0 1px 0 0 #ffffff, 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.04)`). Below the tile, with 16px padding, add a title in Cal Sans 17px weight 700, letter-spacing -0.17px, #242424, then a 4px gap, then a description in Cal Sans 14px weight 400, line height 1.35, #5f6570.

4. Build a sticky navigation bar: 64px tall, positioned 12px from the top, inside a 1320px container. Fill it with #f4f4f4b8 and backdrop-filter blur(12px) at a 14px radius. Place the wordmark left at 22px height. Add ghost links in Cal Sans 14px weight 500 #242424 with 0 14px padding, 36px height and 10px radius, plus a #f3f4f6 hover fill. On the right, add a 24px avatar pair with a 2px #ffffff ring, "Talk to sales", "Sign in", and the 36px #242424 ink button with a 12px radius.

5. Build a testimonial card: background #ffffff, 20px radius, 24px padding, 420px width, box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07)`, no border. Set the quote in Cal Sans 16px weight 400, line height 1.5, #242424. Then add a 16px gap and a footer row with a 24px full-round avatar, the name in 14px weight 500 #242424 and the role in 13px weight 400 #5f6570, with an 8px gap between them.

## Ink-Only Action

The discipline is that the most important pixel on any page is #242424, not a hue. Most scheduling products, Calendly first among them, hand the CTA a saturated blue. Cal.com withholds color entirely and lets the 700-weight headline and the ink button share one value. That makes the button feel like part of the sentence. The discipline breaks the moment a tinted fill appears anywhere outside a status label: an emerald "Get started", a blue link color, a lavender feature tile. Each of those creates a second hierarchy competing with the type. To extend the system, add emphasis through weight (500 to 700), through scale steps from the type table, or through the ink/hairline button pair. When a new state needs color, express it as a 13px status label inside a product object, never as chrome.

## Ring Not Border

Edges in this system are described by light, not ink. The workhorse is a 1px inset ring at rgba(15, 35, 75, 0.07), a navy-tinted line at 7% that sits inside the radius. Because it is an inset box-shadow rather than a border, it adds zero layout width and stays crisp on 20px and 22px curves. The solid #e5e7eb is reserved for interactive outlines and frames. The discipline breaks under a conventional 1px solid gray border on cards, because it doubles the visual weight. It also breaks under any blur radius above 3px, which converts flat paper into floating stickers. Extend it by choosing among three moves only: ring for containment, #f3f4f6 for recession, and the md triple for raised mockup panels.

## One-Family Typesetting

Cal Sans sets the 11px badge, the 14px body and the 80px hero, and every bold size carries the same -0.01em tracking. That makes the page read as a single typeset sheet rather than a pairing of display and text faces. The hierarchy is binary: weight 700 for anything that names, and 400/500 for anything that explains. This one-face, ink-only approach is the thesis made typographic. It breaks under a second family in marketing copy, under 600-weight headlines that blur the binary, or under positive tracking anywhere except caps badges. System UI stays quarantined inside mockups. To extend it, add sizes only from the scale, keep new headings at 700 with proportional negative tracking, and let size jumps of 1.4 do the dramatic work.

## Similar Brands

- **Vercel** — the same black-filled primary button on a white canvas with Tailwind-gray hairlines; Vercel leans on Geist and pure black, while Cal.com uses a softer #242424 and rounder 12px corners.
- **Calendly** — the direct category competitor with product-mockup heroes; Calendly spends a saturated blue on every CTA, which is exactly the move Cal.com refuses.
- **Resend** — a developer-facing product site with monochrome type-led hierarchy and inset ring edges; Resend runs dark where Cal.com stays on #ffffff.
- **Linear** — tight negative tracking on bold headlines and real app screenshots as the primary imagery; Linear adds gradient glows that Cal.com omits entirely.
- **Notion** — warm photographic texture subordinated to black type and an ink CTA; Notion illustrates where Cal.com dithers photographs.
